Title: Bible verses for anxiety and worry
Description: “Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.” (1 Peter 5:7) Bible verses for anxiety, grouped by what you're feeling: worry about tomorrow, fear that won't settle, and the need for peace. Short reflections included.

Title: Versículos bíblicos para la ansiedad
Description: “Echando toda vuestra solicitud en él, porque él tiene cuidado de vosotros.” (1 Pedro 5:7) Versículos de la Biblia para la ansiedad, agrupados por lo que sientes: preocupación por el mañana, miedo que no se va y necesidad de paz. Con reflexiones breves.

Title: Bible verses for encouragement
Description: “The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.” (Psalms 34:18) Bible verses for encouragement when you feel low, alone or tired, plus verses for lifting up others. Grouped by need, each with a short reflection.

Title: Morning Bible verses to start your day
Description: “Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail. They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness!” (Lamentations 3:22-23) Start your day with God: 16 morning Bible verses about new mercies, first prayers and waking up, grouped with short reflections you can read in two minutes.

Title: Versículos bíblicos para la mañana
Description: “Es por la misericordia de Jehová que no somos consumidos, porque nunca decayeron sus misericordias. Nuevas son cada mañana; grande es tu fidelidad.” (Lamentaciones 3:22-23) Versículos de la Biblia para leer al despertar: misericordias nuevas cada mañana, oraciones para empezar el día y promesas para lo que viene. Con breves reflexiones.

Title: Versículos de la Biblia para dormir
Description: “En paz me acostaré, y asimismo dormiré; porque solo tú, Jehová, me harás estar confiado.” (Salmos 4:8) Versículos de la Biblia para dormir: textos para antes de acostarte, para la noche en vela y para soltar la preocupación. Con reflexiones breves.

Title: Bible verses about strength
Description: “Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.” (Matthew 11:28) Bible verses about strength for tired, discouraged or overwhelmed days, grouped by what you need, with a short reflection on each group.
